say:1:1260008001:1.text: Early the next morning, an unexpected guest rushes in with news—
say:1:1260008001:1.source_cn: 翌日一大早，一个不速之客就带着新消息冲到了你们面前——

say:3:1260008002:1.text: Leader of the Carmine Whispers! Honorable Mage! I've come to report something!
say:3:1260008002:1.source_cn: 各位！！血薇帮的当家！魔法师大人！我来报案！
say:3:1260008002:1.male: Leader of the Carmine Whispers! Honorable Mage! I've come to report something!
say:3:1260008002:1.female: Leader of the Carmine Whispers! Honorable Mage! I've come to report something!

say:5:1260008003:1.text: I've seen you before, are you a fisherman?
say:5:1260008003:1.source_cn: 你……看起来有点面熟，是供鱼的捕鱼人？

say:6:1260008004:1.text: That's right, I'm Naso, an unofficial member of the Fishing Society, known as the "Seawolf"! My dream is to surpass my master, "Eighty," and catch a hundred-pound fish!
say:6:1260008004:1.source_cn: 没错，我是钓鱼协会编外非记名成员，南森，称号“海狼”！...

say:7:1260008005:1.text: Spare us the irrelevant details. What are you here to report?
say:7:1260008005:1.source_cn: 不需要这些无关信息。你有什么要报告？

say:8:1260008006:1.text: Oh, it's great news! Last night, a few fellow anglers and I went night fishing, and by dawn, we hauled in several massive, incredibly impressive, absolutely amazing fish!
say:8:1260008006:1.source_cn: 啊，是好事！我和几个同好昨晚夜钓，到天亮左右，一口气钓...

say:9:1260008007:1.text: My master's been saying something like this would surely put that old codger "One-Rod" in his place!
say:9:1260008007:1.source_cn: 师父一直说，这样绝对能给“一零一杆”那个臭老头子点颜色看看！

say:10:1260008008:1.text: Uh, well done. But why report this? I thought you'd reeled in a corpse or something like that.
say:10:1260008008:1.source_cn: 呃，恭喜。但为什么要来报案，我还以为你们钓上来无名尸了。

say:11:1260008009:1.text: Ah, you see... those fish were so aggressive, neither my master nor I could control them.
say:11:1260008009:1.source_cn: 啊，是这样……那些鱼有点太凶了，我和师父一起都没法制服。

say:12:1260008010:1.text: Once we hit land, they started lunging at us, nearly killing us both!
say:12:1260008010:1.source_cn: 上岸之后就开始追着我和师父乱捅，差点要了我们俩的命！

say:13:1260008011:1.text: Being quicker, my master told me to rush to the Carmine Whispers for aid...
say:13:1260008011:1.source_cn: 因为我腿脚比较快，师父就催我们快点来找血薇帮的当家们帮...

say:14:1260008012:1.text: Hold on, fish? On land? Chasing and attacking people?!

choice_prompt:15:1260008012.text: Hold on, fish? On land? Chasing and attacking people?!

say:16:1260008013:1.text: Bigger and taller than humans! They can wield fishing rods as weapons and make howling noises!
say:16:1260008013:1.source_cn: 您怎么知道我们钓上了比人还高大的鱼！它们能把鱼竿当做武...
say:16:1260008013:1.male: Bigger and taller than humans! They can wield fishing rods as weapons and make howling noises!
say:16:1260008013:1.female: Bigger and taller than humans! They can wield fishing rods as weapons and make howling noises!

say:18:1260008015:0.text: Larger than humans, wielding weapons... they can't be fish, can they?!
say:18:1260008015:0.source_cn: 比人还高大，拿着武器……那根本不是鱼吧？！

say:19:1260008016:1.text: Are you talking about those fish-like monsters that show up near the Blackthorn Sea... if we can even refer to them as fish-like...
say:19:1260008016:1.source_cn: 你们说的该不是黑棘海附近出没的那些鱼怪吧……呃，这样说...

say:20:1260008017:1.text: Let's not waste time unpacking this. Move! This might be the work of that Graveborn!
say:20:1260008017:1.source_cn: 别慢悠悠分析了，给我跑起来，可能又是那个亡灵下的手！

choice:15:0:1.text: What did those fish look like?
choice:15:0:1.male: What did those fish look like?
choice:15:0:1.female: What did those fish look like?

say:23:1260008014:1.text: Enormous! They're half a head taller than me at least!
say:23:1260008014:1.source_cn: 您怎么知道我们钓上了比人还高大的鱼！它们比我还高出半个头！
say:23:1260008014:1.male: Enormous! They're half a head taller than me at least!
say:23:1260008014:1.female: Enormous! They're half a head taller than me at least!
